title: Mattermost versions 11.7.x <= 11.7.11 fail to sanitize channel mentions when rendering permalinked posts, which allows…
description: Mattermost versions 11.7.x up to 11.7.11 have a vulnerability where channel mentions in permalinked posts are not properly sanitized. This flaw allows authenticated users to discover the display names of private channels they do not have access to by viewing permalinked posts that mention those channels.
